downloadTask.title: Download Task
downloadTask.description: A media download or extraction request created by a user

id.description: Unique identifier of the download task

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

url.description: Target media URL to extract or download

format.description: Selected download format or quality preset

status.description: Current processing state of the download task

fileSize.description: Human-readable size of the downloaded media

muxingStatus.description: Status of audio track muxing for 4K and adaptive streams

batchId.description: Identifier of parent playlist batch if part of a collection

playlistName.description: Name of the source playlist or album

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when task was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when task was last modified

botSetting.title: Bot Setting
botSetting.description: User specific configuration for Telegram Bot Downloader

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user

autoDownload.description: Whether bot automatically processes sent media links

targetChatId.description: Telegram chat ID to send completed files to

notificationEnabled.description: Flag indicating if notifications are enabled

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last settings update

/users/{userId}/downloads/{downloadId}.description: User download history and active media tasks

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: User preferences and Telegram bot target options
